message: Fallible function must return an explicit result type, not bare values with raise ambiguity

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' is fallible (raises) but return type is not Result[T]

rationale: Fallible operations that raise must surface failure in the type system. A bare return type that can also raise forces callers to guess. Explicit result types (success value + failure message) are self-documenting and statically analyzable. Pure functions without raise are outside this obligation.
remediation: Return a typed Result[T] (or equivalent explicit result type) with success/failure discrimination. Catch local failures and convert them at the boundary of the fallible work.
